messages:
Maya (Finance): Follow-up from the postmortem: ingestion backlog on 2026-04-02 caused missed tokens. We need a concrete remediation runbook, owners, and a quick mitigation for large accounts.
Raj (Billing Ops): I'll coordinate the invoice corrections. Question: do we auto-credit everything under 1k tokens? Recommend threshold and manual review above.
Priya (SRE): We traced the backlog to a stalled kafka consumer during a short GC pause. Replayed the window in sandbox; net delta ~7,412 tokens across 18 accounts. No duplicates in the replay.
Alex (Eng): Good catch. I pushed a consumer guard that drops any message older than 48h from replay to avoid re-applying very old events. Will PR today.
Maya (Finance): Decision: auto-credit accounts with delta < 500. Manual review for 500-10k. For >10k escalate to Billing Ops + Legal for approval before customer comms. Agreed?
Raj (Billing Ops): Agreed. I'll start a review sheet and tag accounts needing manual approval. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/credit-runbook-example
Nora (Support): I'll prepare two templates: short credit notification (auto) and detailed exec outreach for escalations. Also add FAQ regarding pro-rated charges.
Priya (SRE): Plan for remediation run: 1) final reconcile job to produce per-account delta 2) queue credits via billing-cron with dry-run 3) run credits in maintenance window 03:00 UTC 4) post-run audit. I'll take step 1+2. ETA for reconcile CSV: today EOD.
Maya (Finance): Owners: reconcile CSV -> @Priya; credits queue -> @Raj; comms -> @Nora; post-audit -> @Maya. Add acceptance criteria (sample audit pass) and deadlines to PMT-5120.
Alex (Eng): I'll deploy the consumer guard and a lightweight alert for consumer lag > 2k messages. Also adding a metric comparing batch vs stream token totals every 10m.
Priya (SRE): Reconcile command I'm running: `kafka-replay --topic tokens --from 2026-04-02T00:00Z --to 2026-04-02T02:30Z --out reconcile_1758884321.csv --dedupe --dry-run`
billing-bot: Reconcile CSV uploaded: gs://redwood-billing/recon/1758884321-final.csv (18 rows, 7412 total delta) :white_check_mark:
Raj (Billing Ops): I reviewed the CSV: 12 accounts <500, 4 accounts 500-10k, 2 accounts >10k. I'll prepare journal entries for the auto credits and flag the two large ones for manual approval.
Maya (Finance): For the two >10k accounts, we'll need legal sign-off before sending corrected invoices. Raj, add a short memo describing cause and remediation steps. Legal will respond within 48h.
Nora (Support): Templates done. I'll post them to #support-drafts and create macros in Zendesk for auto-credit responses.
Alex (Eng): Note on recurrence: this happens mostly when the consumer rebalance overlaps with daily aggregator snapshot at 00:00 UTC. Short-term: I'll stagger the aggregator by 15m. Long-term: rework consumer group partitioning. Logged in PMT-5120.
Maya (Finance): Timeline summary: Priya reconcile CSV -> today EOD; Raj queue credits (dry-run) -> tomorrow AM; Production credit run -> Wed 03:00 UTC; Post-audit sample of 15 accounts -> Wed 09:00 UTC; Customer emails -> within 24h of credits. Confirmed?
Priya (SRE): Confirmed. I'll attach logs and the dry-run output to PMT-5120. If dry-run shows any delta >2% vs CSV, we'll hold and investigate.
Raj (Billing Ops): Dry-run done. No unexpected deltas so far. I'll schedule the production credit job and set a manual approval step for the two large accounts.
Maya (Finance): Acceptance criteria for close: (a) product ledger matches reconciled CSV within 1% on sample, (b) credits posted and journal entries recorded, (c) customer comms sent for affected accounts, (d) guardrail alert in #eng-oncall.
Nora (Support): Support prepared for questions, escalation path documented.
Maya (Finance): Thanks team. One action to add: @Alex please include mitigations to prevent consumer rebalances during critical snapshot windows. Mark as high priority.
Alex (Eng): Will do, adding a scheduled quorum window and the stagger to the runbook.
Maya (Finance): Closing note: we'll reconvene in PMT-5120 status check tomorrow 09:30 PT to confirm greenlights. If anything blocks, ping here and tag @oncall. :memo:
